label: owner must pay contractor (holdback)
basis: lien period (60) + owner has 14 days to pay after expiry — up to 74 days from the event with no preserved lien

label: contractor passes down (if paid on the due date)
basis: 14 days after receipt to pay downstream parties

label: holdback to retain (amount, not a date)
basis: CAD 80,000.00 x 10% = CAD 8,000.00 retained. The statute applies the rate to the price of the services or materials supplied; you chose the base (check with your accountant or lawyer whether tax is in it). Rounded half-up to the cent (the rounding rule is not stated in the text we read - unverified).
